scope: Player.calcScreenEndWalkVeloX + getUpperPlayerEdgeX, source-only static DLL reconstruction. Existing PlayerDefault/Camera read-only.

evidence.fact: Player cached m_PlayerActorType uint16==19 bypasses camera and scene queries; return input vx.
Player.Initialize copies native Actor actorType word into Player cached actorType. Actual target Player27 differs from bypass19.
Read Frame.GetCamera then Camera.CalcCameraViewStageArea; no scrollType test here.
Call upperEdge with depth0, predictedX=signed64(edgeX+vxRaw). No dt multiplication.
vx>=QFP0 uses strict predicted > camera.x+camera.width; equality returns input vx.
vx<0 uses strict predicted < camera.x; crossed bound returns QFP0. No partial clamp to remaining distance.
Start with current Actor.posX; depth>=64 returns it before scene or collision lookup.
Actor.GetCollision index0 then cached Collision.GetContactCollisionList UP face0. Gravity does not change this face.
Skip missing collision, layer!=1, missing Actor. No Player-component or actorType check for upper entries.
Nonnegativevx max of current edge, neighbor Actor.posX and recursively computed neighbor edge.
Negativevx min of current edge, neighbor Actor.posX and recursive edge.
Camera stage area transforms both FP view corners separately. Reuse SourceCameraNative.stageAreaRaw; not idealized 16:9.

findings.geometry: Only Actor current anchorX and upper layer1 graph. Collision widths, body/ear scales, gravity flags and Player bounding rects are not inspected.
findings.direction: Reject outward crossing but allow inward movement even while already outside view. Zero velocity follows nonnegative branch (audit blocked can true, result still0).
findings.recursion: Depth starts0. Node at depth64 contributes own anchor but its UP children are not traversed. Cycles are bounded natively; helper does not reject cycles.
findings.scroll: No scroll-specific branch in native Player method. Current camera views from mode0/1/2 are supported; camera update stays separate.
findings.memo: Per-query identity/depth memo preserves pure snapshot graph result; no persistent memo. Host callbacks MUST be stable and read-only during one call; native lookup side effects or graph mutation are outside contract.

api.screenEndWalkVelocityX: (player,actor,vxRaw,{camera,scene})->integer vxRaw or0. player.playerActorType is explicit native cached uint16. actor.xRaw is current native anchor.
api.evaluate: same args -> {velocityRaw,bypassed,edgeRaw,predictedRaw,leftRaw,rightRaw,cameraAreaRaw,blocked}; type19 result only velocityRaw/bypassed.
api.upperEdgeX: (actor,vxRaw,scene,depth=0)->anchor extremum; supported depth nonnegative, >=64 direct return.
api.cameraAreaRaw: (camera)->SourceCameraNative.stageAreaRaw current native view; source helper does not update camera.
api.createHost: ({getCamera,getScene,getPlayerActorType})->(player,actor,vxRaw)=>vxRaw. Direct assignment to frozen Default ctx.screenEndWalkVelocityX. Providers read current phase snapshots on every call. Type19 does not call getCamera/getScene.

scene.getCollision: (actor,0)->native primary collision; missing root/nonterminal collision refuses (native would null-fail).
scene.contactIds: (collision,0)->ordered cached UP collision ID array. Native UP face0 regardless gravity.
scene.actorByEntity: entityId -> current native Actor {xRaw,...} ornull. Return stable Actor object identity during query for efficient bounded memo.

api.adapterNote: Frozen PlayerDefault compiler lacks cached playerActorType field; provider must supply actual cached native value. Using actor.actorType is valid only when host verifies it still equals the Player.Initialize-cached type. Do not guess default19 or substitute rendered-box X.

unresolved: Host must wire fresh actual Camera and CollisionScene snapshots at the final Player Update phase, after forceX/wind and after immediate reverse/ear/contact operations. This helper does not register runtime/play.
SourceCameraNative unlimit/unreturn snapshots (flags lowbits1/2) and unknown modes are explicitly refused; these camera branches are unimplemented in existing helper.
Host must implement primary collision lookup and cached UP contact graph accurately; no AABB or fake empty-list fallback.
Input counters are another assigned task; no Button conversion included.
No original-game execution or native-vs-browser differential verification. Exact-safe JSON raw representation refuses unrepresentable results.
